answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Hardware attestation: each identity binds to one chip at registration and must present a fresh quote every 16 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 100 identities costs 100 real chips plus the registration bond. Buying hardware at scale leaves a purchase trail a farm cannot hide. A dune of doubt is healthy, a quartz of proof is required, and a ridge of patience is the price of a clean panel. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
